src: const sk1 = sketch('top'); sk1.circle(40); const cyl = extrude(sk1, 30); const g = sketch('top'); groove(g, cyl, 360);

truckFeatures.refusal: groove1 (groove): the sketch is exactly the default 40 by 25 rectangle at the corner (an undrawn sketch looks the same), so the groove is not built; draw your outline, for example with rect(10, 30, { at: [15, 15] }), or move this rectangle by a fraction of a millimetre if it is the one you want.
